283.name: The Few, The Proud, The Brave

Q00255_Tutorial/32133-001.htm.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: Welcome. I am Vice Hierarch Perwan, and I am in charge of this place. This cave is revered ground for the Kamael. Did you bring the diploma from the Newbie Guide?

Q00255_Tutorial/32133-004.htm.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: Go to Kamael Village and meet the Newbie Guide there. He will advise you further, as well as give you another useful item.

Q00255_Tutorial/32133-003.htm.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: First you must learn the basic methods of control in the game. Go to the Newbie Guide over there. Listen carefully to what he tells you. It will prove very useful later in the game.

Q00175_TheWayOfTheWarrior/32133-01.html.text: Perwan: I met you not long ago, and yet here you are preparing for your warrior ritual. Excellent! There is something you must do first, however. Go to the Hills of Gold and obtain 5 lovely Wolf Tails . Leave the rest to me.

Q00175_TheWayOfTheWarrior/32133-02.html.text: Perwan: Did you forget what I told you? Go to the Hills of Gold and obtain 5 lovely Werewolf tail pelts.

Q00175_TheWayOfTheWarrior/32133-03.html.text: Perwan: Well done! Now return to Hierarch Kekropus and listen to his words while I prepare these things. He will tell you the reason why you must undergo these formalities. After your curiosity has been satisfied, everything will be ready for you. Go, make haste!

Q00175_TheWayOfTheWarrior/32133-04.html.text: Perwan: This will take some time to prepare, so go to Hierarch Kekropus and listen to his words.

Q00175_TheWayOfTheWarrior/32133-05.html.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: The preparations are complete. You understand now why they were necessary, right? Then be seated, close your eyes and tell me when you are ready to begin.

Q00175_TheWayOfTheWarrior/32133-07.html.text: Perwan: Why are you still here? Go to Hierarch Kekropus immediately!

Q00283_TheFewTheProudTheBrave/32133-01.h.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: The moment you entered, your determination shone forth like a bright blade. I have a task perfectly suited for your abilities. Recently, I received a report that many people have been attacked by Crimson Spiders near Mimir's Forest. Since the road that connects the town and No…

Q00283_TheFewTheProudTheBrave/32133-02.h.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: I will pose you this question: Suppose you find yourself in a precarious situation; what is your most effective weapon? Power? Experience? Skill? Very important, all of them. But think of something even more essential for victory. Courage! That is the mark of the true Warrior.…

Q00283_TheFewTheProudTheBrave/32133-04.h.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: Battle trophies are worth a thousand war stories. So it is with this mission. Prove your bravery and skill with some evidence of your victory.

links.text: Show him the Crimson Spider Claws.

Q00283_TheFewTheProudTheBrave/32133-05.h.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: Have you really defeated the Crimson Spiders? If so, you should have brought their claws as proof... If you forgot to do so, go back to Mimir's Forest and collect them now. But if you are lying to me, stop now!

Q00175_TheWayOfTheWarrior/32133-06.html.text: Perwan: Wait a moment -- don't move. Ah, we are ready! Now go to Hierarch Kekropus to be acknowledged as a true Kamael Warrior.

Q00255_Tutorial/32133-002.htm.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: Well done! You have learned the basic methods of control in the game. From now on, you can really enjoy your adventures. Take this gift. Did you already hear the explanation about how to use it? Now go to Kamael Village and meet the Newbie Guide there. He will advise you furth…

Q00283_TheFewTheProudTheBrave/32133-03.h.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: I knew I could entrust you with this mission! Now listen carefully. Kill the Crimson Spiders, no matter how many you find. Collect the Crimson Spider Claws as proof. The Crimson Spiders have been seen recently in Mimir's Forest, but they also live in other habitats. Good luck!

Q00283_TheFewTheProudTheBrave/32133-06.h.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: Oh, you will continue the mission? That is what I had hoped to hear! Return then to Mimir's Forest and continue to slay the Crimson Spiders you find there. Bring back their claws as proof of your victory.

Q00283_TheFewTheProudTheBrave/32133-07.h.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: Have you really defeated the Crimson Spiders? If so, you should have brought their claws as proof... If you forgot to do so, go back to Mimir's Forest and collect them now. But if you are lying to me, stop now!

Q00283_TheFewTheProudTheBrave/32133-08.h.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: Well done. You carried out your mission admirably. You have justified my faith in you as a powerful warrior! Will you continue with this mission? You have certainly proved your skill. If your circumstances will not permit it, however...

Q00283_TheFewTheProudTheBrave/32133-09.h.text: Vice Hierarch Perwan: You seem to have more pressing matters to attend to, so I will not stop you. But should you ever wish to test your courage, come back to me.
